otpChannel.description: Where a code goes. A client treats an unknown value as sms when it words the screen.

phone_start.description: The phone_start RPC: a code for the number. Without a channel the server tries WhatsApp, then SMS; sms sends by SMS only, for the "send by SMS instead" button. Every send counts against the same resend wait and limits.

phone_started.description: phone_start's answer when a code went out; a refusal is { ok: false, error } with an auth.otp_* or table.invalid_payload code

phone.description: The number masked: country code and last two digits

channels.description: The channels the server can send on, in the order it tries them; offer "send by SMS instead" only when it holds sms

fallback.description: WhatsApp was tried first and failed, so the code went by SMS
